steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Definition: A review evaluates a product, service, or creative work, providing a judgment supported by evidence to help readers make informed decisions. | Include: Title and type of work/product Key details (author, director, release date) A brief overview of what it's about An engaging hook to interest readers | Key Elements: Discuss specific aspects (acting, directing, plot, etc.) Use examples to illustrate your points Balance positive and negative aspects Use new paragraphs for different aspects | Include: Clear overall judgment Who would enjoy this Star rating or recommendation Final memorable comment

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: What are the four key elements of an effective review? | Why should you avoid major spoilers in a film or book review? | Write an introduction for a review of a restaurant you've visited.

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on Include, Key Elements, Include, and one past-paper question.
